نفتلي (form VIII)
# نَفْتَلِي (naftalī) /naf.ta.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
# نَفْتَلِيَ (naftaliya) /naf.ta.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
